REST API reference

All endpoints live under /v2 and require a bearer token.

List widgets

GET /v2/widgets returns every registered widget with its status and firmware version.

Calibrate a widget

POST /v2/widgets/{serial}/calibrate starts the calibration routine. Calibration takes about ninety seconds and the widget reports CALIBRATING until it finishes.

See advanced calibration internals.
